proposal.reason: Main change is a new built-in TROCE GIN backend (type 16) with substantial host/device GIN implementation: backend registration, context lifecycle, MR handling, device API specializations, and TROCE-specific queue/CQ progress logic. Added network because the PR also makes independently substantive net_ib provider-layer changes (new IB provider type, provider detection in init, shared IB helper exposure, and optional libtroce provider wiring) that affect shared transport/backend setup beyond mechanical call-site edits.
